description: Implementation of ProductAttributeDao for data access related to product attributes, involving database queries using QueryDSL and JPA.

classes.name: ProductAttributeDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for ProductAttribute management, extending generic CRUD support and implementing custom query methods.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a ProductAttribute by its ID, along with related product options and descriptions.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes associated with a specific product option ID within a store.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes matching a list of attribute IDs within a store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Fetches ProductAttributes associated with a specific product option value ID within a store.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves all ProductAttributes for a given product, store, and language, including descriptions.
